comparison.objective: Move a fragile egg off a trivet before placing a pot there.
comparison.physical_skill: Gentle obstruction removal followed by stable heavier-object placement.
comparison.success_condition: Keep the egg supported, avoid pot–egg contact above 0.20 N or any fall, and release a stable pot on the cleared trivet.
comparison.reason: Shares damage avoidance and force sensitivity only generically; it tests prerequisite obstacle relocation rather than intentional controlled fracture and fragment recovery.
